summary: Implemented the Tabs feature in the repository without running any tests or code, and without committing. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges before width and now yields one Text with @click spans appended last; Opacity merges the blended colour into the existing style so metadata is kept; _layout_resolve.py gained a concrete LayoutEdge dataclass. Added tests in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and test_opacity.py (existing tests unchanged) and tests/test_tabs.py, plus docs/reference/tabs.md and sandbox/tabs_demo.py with tabs_demo.css. Everything is unverified because I did not run the tests. Choices made: the stored bar position stays a full-list index and is mapped to the displayed tab at render time, so duplicate names share one underline; letter search only applies to single-character keys; empty labels get no label edge. Known issues: Tabs is not focusable (Widget.can_focus defaults to False), so keyboard input only reaches it if focus is enabled, which I did not add; Escape's bare un-awaited set_focus call will log a "coroutine never awaited" warning; the project pins rich 11.2.0, which is not installed here, so Style and Text.apply_meta behaviour was checked against a newer vendored copy only.
